title: Cocktails Clipart PNG Files

description:
Cocktails Clipart PNG files
Download these fun, cocktail recipe clipart designs, suitable for a range of possible product ideas including: Greeting cards, invitations, menus, recipe cards, digital papers, scrapbooking and more…
Includes 14 different cocktail illustrations!
Cosmopolitan
Mojito

Old Fashioned

French 75
Bloody Mary
Mai Tai
Margarita
Blue Lagoon
